A classe Ponto de Início de Drenagem faz parte da categoria Hidrografia da Base Cartográfica do Estado de Roraima. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Roraima, Base Cartográfica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
